_info: Panel UI translations PT-BR -> EN. Keys are the Portuguese text exactly as it appears in desktop/painel.html (or in server messages). Applied at runtime on rendered text (longest match first).
Tree read from the main router.
Faça login no roteador principal para ve: Log in to the main router to see the full tree.
Reiniciar derruba a rede por ~1–2 minuto: Restarting drops the network for ~1–2 minutes. Powering off requires unplugging and plugging the device back in.
The network will be down for 1–2 minutes.
It only comes back after re-plugging it.
Com ele ligado, 2,4 e 5 GHz usam o mesmo: When on, 2.4 and 5 GHz share one name and the router picks the band for each device. May cause drops on some devices.
Permite ao roteador falar com vários apa: Lets the router talk to several devices at once. Only helps if the device supports it too.
Procura aparelhos inteligentes Xiaomi nã: Looks for unconfigured Xiaomi smart devices. The firmware itself warns: it may increase packet loss and latency on congested networks.
Reserva o 2,4 GHz para estabilidade de c: Reserves 2.4 GHz for device connection stability. The firmware warns: it may affect the link between Mesh routers and cause brief disconnections when enabled.
O Wi-Fi reinicia e os aparelhos caem por: Wi-Fi restarts and devices drop for ~30 s.
O nome não pode ser igual ao da rede 2,4: The name can't be the same as the 2.4 GHz network.
Vai aplicar nome e senha e ligar a rede: This will apply the name and password and turn the guest network on. If the router refuses it (code 1615), change the name/password in the app.
Vai ligar a rede de visitante (leva de 5: This will turn the guest network on (takes 5 to 30 s; the home Wi-Fi stays up).
Vai desligar a rede de visitante (leva d: This will turn the guest network off (takes 5 to 30 s; the home Wi-Fi stays up).
Rede isolada para visitantes, removida d: Isolated network for guests, removed from the UI by the firmware. On/off uses set_wifi_without_restart (index 3): applies in seconds without dropping the home Wi-Fi (the old set_wifi is accepted but ignored). Only exists on the main router — the repeater doesn't broadcast it. After saving, the panel re-reads the settings to check.
Pode desconectar aparelhos brevemente e: May briefly disconnect devices and affect the Mesh link.
Para aparelhos antigos que não encontram: For older devices that can't find or join Wi-Fi 6. Turns on Wi-Fi 5 mode and disables Wi-Fi 6 features (OFDMA, BSS Coloring).
Descobre automaticamente aparelhos Wi-Fi: Automatically discovers new compatible Wi-Fi devices to set up in the Mi Home app; also syncs password changes with them.
Força aparelhos com sinal muito fraco a: Forces devices with a very weak signal to reconnect (usually to the other Mesh router). Negative values in dBm.
Na rede Mesh não é possível desligar o W: Wi-Fi can't be turned off on a Mesh network. Saving restarts Wi-Fi (~30 s drops).
Atenção: errar aqui derruba a internet d: Warning: a mistake here takes the home internet down. Current: ISP PPPoE with the modem in bridge mode.
A internet da casa vai cair e reconectar: The home internet will drop and reconnect. If anything is wrong, it won't come back.
A internet da casa fica fora até reconec: The home internet stays down until it reconnects.
A rede de casa passa a usar o prefixo fi: The home network will use the fixed prefix fd00:6868:6868::/64. Devices that kept the old prefix (like Home Assistant) may need one restart.
Atenção: no modo nativo o prefixo da red: Warning: in native mode the network prefix changes on every internet reconnection. Devices pile up stale addresses and Matter (Google/Alexa) may stop working until the server is restarted.
NAT6: a rede de casa usa um prefixo próp: NAT6: the home network uses its own fixed prefix (fd00:6868:6868::/64) and the router translates to the internet — ISP prefix changes don't affect devices. Native: passes the ISP prefix through, which changes on every reconnection; devices keep stale addresses and that can break Matter (Google/Alexa).
Atenção: aparelhos Apple trocam o MAC (e: Warning: Apple devices rotate their MAC (private address) — the block may not hold. Changing the network password is more effective.
Garanta que este PC fique na lista, senã: Make sure this PC stays on the list, or you'll lose access.
Só estes aparelhos podem abrir a adminis: Only these devices can open the admin page
Hands out IP addresses automatically on the network.
Sem DHCP, aparelhos novos não recebem IP: Without DHCP, new devices won't get an IP.
O roteador reinicia. Todas as reservas e: The router restarts. All reservations and integrations that use 192.168.0.x may break.

No repetidor, fuso e hora vêm do roteado: On the repeater, time zone and time come from the main router via Mesh — change them there.
O roteador gera um arquivo com os regist: The router generates a file with the system logs — useful to investigate hangs.
O Wi-Fi reinicia. Canais/potência mudam: Wi-Fi restarts. Channels/power change with the region.
Only generates a file — changes nothing.
Isto APAGA toda a configuração e a inter: This ERASES all settings and the home internet stops working until it is set up again.
O QoS classifica e limita o tráfego de c: QoS classifies and limits each device's traffic. It uses a lot of CPU on this router — if the router hangs under load, turning QoS off is a good test.
O que este painel expõe além da interfac: What this panel exposes beyond the original UI
Chamada direta à API interna. Funções qu: Direct call to the internal API. Functions that change something ask for confirmation.
Executar função que altera o roteador: Run a function that changes the router
Panel closed. You can close this tab.

Painel local · somente neste computador: Local panel · this computer only · changes always ask for confirmation
Painel no celular · fala direto com os r: Phone panel · talks directly to the routers on the home network · changes always ask for confirmation
função que não aparece na interface orig: function not shown in the original UI
A senha vai direto ao roteador (mesmo mé: The password goes straight to the router (same method as the original UI) and is not stored.
Para mudar, use o app — exige reconfigur: To change it, use the app — it requires reconfiguring both networks together.
WPA3 pode não funcionar em aparelhos ant: WPA3 may not work on older devices
não pode ser igual ao da rede 2,4 GHz: can't be the same as the 2.4 GHz network
só necessário se a operadora prender a c: only needed if the ISP locks the connection to one device
Por segurança, troque pela interface ori: For security, change it in the original UI (Security → Admin password) — it uses its own encryption.
mudar exige reiniciar e muda o endereço: changing it requires a restart and changes this page's address
na Mesh, defina no principal (é repassad: on Mesh, set it on the main router (it is passed on to the repeater)
o firmware chinês não tem português nem: the Chinese firmware has neither Portuguese nor English
Fuso sem horário de verão + acertar hora: Time zone without daylight saving + set time from this PC
Bloquear internet por aparelho, velocida: Block internet per device, real-time speeds
Escolha uma função à esquerda para ver o: Pick a function on the left to see what it does.

Se um roteador mudar de IP, corrija aqui: If a router's IP changes, fix it here. Saved in %APPDATA%\MiWiFiPainel.
Log in to this router first.
Este endpoint altera o roteador: confirm: This endpoint changes the router: confirm first.
Function only available in the PC panel.
A rede de casa usa o prefixo fixo fd00:6: The home network uses the fixed prefix fd00:6868:6868::/64.
O prefixo muda a cada reconexão da opera: The prefix changes on every ISP reconnection.
Use só se a operadora forneceu endereço: Use only if your ISP provided a fixed address and prefix.
Devices are left with IPv4 only.
Preencha IPv6 da WAN, gateway, prefixo e: Fill in WAN IPv6, gateway, prefix and DNS 1.
O prefixo da LAN precisa terminar em ::: The LAN prefix must end with ::
Se algum dado estiver errado, o IPv6 da: If any value is wrong, IPv6 stops working at home.
NAT6: a rede de casa usa um prefixo próp: NAT6: the home network uses its own fixed prefix (fd00:6868:6868::/64) and the router translates to the internet — ISP prefix changes don't affect devices. Native: passes on the ISP prefix, which changes on every reconnection; devices keep old addresses and that can break Matter (Google/Alexa). Static: fixed address and prefix provided by the ISP.
A interface oficial não permite trocar o: The official interface doesn't allow changing the mode of the Mesh main router. To use another mode, undo the Mesh first (restore the node as a regular router).
a busca leva alguns segundos: the search takes a few seconds
mesmo nome e senha da rede estendida: same name and password as the extended network
Roteador: cria a própria rede e faz a co: Router: creates its own network and makes the internet connection. Wireless repeater: extends an existing Wi-Fi network. Wired repeater: the WAN port connects to an existing router and this one becomes just an access point. In repeater modes the guest network is turned off, Mesh stops working and several functions are blocked; the admin address changes (assigned by the other router).
O roteador volta a todas as configuraçõe: The router restores all the settings it had as a router and restarts the network (about 30 s). The admin address goes back to its own network's.
Ligue a porta WAN deste roteador numa po: Connect this router's WAN port to a LAN port of the other router first.
Este roteador deixa de fazer a conexão c: This router stops making the internet connection and gets its address from the other router. The admin address changes — see the new IP in the final message or on the other router.
Escolha a rede (Procurar) ou digite o no: Choose the network (Search) or type its name.
Preencha o novo nome e uma senha de 8 a: Fill in the new name and a password of 8 to 63 characters.
Este roteador passa a estender a rede es: This router will extend the chosen network. If the password is wrong, it stays without internet until it goes back to router mode (via the new IP or the reset button).
Atualize o endereço deste roteador em ⚙: Update this router's address in ⚙ Routers (or in the HA integration) if it changed.
Este IP já está reservado para: This IP is already reserved for
A reserva nova foi criada, mas a antiga: The new reservation was created, but the old one was not removed.
Liga um nome fixo (domínio) ao IP públic: Binds a fixed name (domain) to the home's public IP, which changes on every reconnection. Only one service can be active at a time.
Fill in username, password and domain.
a porta aberta na internet: the port open to the internet
Libera uma porta da internet para um apa: Opens a port from the internet to a device at home. New, edited or removed rules only take effect after "Apply rules".
as mesmas portas no aparelho: the same ports on the device
Faz as regras de encaminhamento (portas: Makes the forwarding rules (ports and ranges) take effect. Takes a few seconds.
recebe todas as conexões vindas da inter: receives every incoming internet connection that has no rule
Expõe um aparelho inteiro à internet. Us: Exposes a whole device to the internet. Use only if you know what you're doing.
Salvo. Clique em \"Aplicar regras\" para: Saved. Click "Apply rules" for it to take effect.
Preencha todos os campos (porta final ≥: Fill in all fields (end port ≥ start port).
Todas as portas sem regra vão para: All ports without a rule go to
O roteador se conecta a um servidor VPN: The router connects to a VPN server (PPTP or L2TP) and sends the home's traffic through it.
Only the addresses below go through the VPN.
Only the devices below use the VPN.
Desligada: todo o tráfego passa pela VPN: Off: all traffic goes through the VPN when it's connected.
Escolhe o que passa pela VPN: só alguns: Chooses what goes through the VPN: only some sites/services or only some devices. Needs the VPN connected; applies from the next connection.
Mantém o acesso remoto do app Xiaomi fun: Keeps the Xiaomi app's remote access working when internet goes out through the VPN. Turning it on disconnects the VPN (reconnect afterwards) and turns off smart split.
Todo o tráfego da casa passa a sair pela: All home traffic will go out through the VPN.
Não conectar a VPN ao ligar: Don't connect the VPN on startup
Vale a partir da próxima conexão da VPN;: Applies from the next VPN connection; "Xiaomi services via VPN" is turned off.
A VPN será desconectada; reconecte depoi: The VPN will be disconnected; reconnect afterwards for it to take effect.
Nenhuma porta aberta por UPnP no momento: No ports currently opened by UPnP.
Deixa aparelhos e programas (consoles, c: Lets devices and programs (consoles, video calls, Chromecast) open ports by themselves. Turning it off improves security, but some apps may stop working properly.
Coloque o roteador novo perto do princip: Place the new router near the main one (up to 3 m) and plug it in.
Wait for the system light to turn blue.
Inclui outro roteador Xiaomi compatível: Adds another compatible Xiaomi router to the Mesh network, like the original interface. The new node copies the main router's Wi-Fi.
Nenhum nó encontrado. Confira se ele est: No node found. Check that it's on, nearby and with a blue light.
sinal fraco, aproxime do principal: weak signal, move it closer to the main router
Leva alguns minutos; não desligue os rot: It takes a few minutes; don't turn the routers off.
Falhou. Aproxime o nó do principal e ten: Failed. Move the node closer to the main router and try again.
Sem resposta depois de 6 minutos. Confir: No answer after 6 minutes. Check the Mesh page.
Muda a potência das duas bandas de uma v: Changes the power of both bands at once in about 5 s, without restarting the Wi-Fi (tested). To set each band separately, use the forms below (they restart the Wi-Fi).
2.4 and 5 GHz, without restarting the Wi-Fi.
As duas bandas passam a usar o nome e a: Both bands will use the 2.4 GHz name and password
Aparelhos ligados ao nome do 5 GHz: Devices connected to the 5 GHz name
vão precisar se conectar de novo. O Wi-F: will need to reconnect. The Wi-Fi restarts (about 30 s).
O 5 GHz volta a ter nome próprio: o rote: 5 GHz gets its own name again: the router uses the 2.4 GHz name ending in _5G and the same password (you can change it later). The Wi-Fi restarts (about 30 s).

Ligue o QoS para ver e limitar os aparel: Turn QoS on to see and limit devices.
Velocidade máxima de cada aparelho em KB: Maximum speed of each device in KB/s (1 Mbps ≈ 125 KB/s); 0 = no limit. Applies with QoS on.
Limita o tráfego gerado pelo próprio rot: Limits the traffic generated by the router itself (updates, Xiaomi services), not the devices'.
Use valores entre 0 e a banda contratada: Use values between 0 and the contracted bandwidth.
Enviar e escolher o que restaurar: Upload and choose what to restore
Gera um arquivo com Wi-Fi, rede local e: Creates a file with Wi-Fi, local network and other settings, or restores a backup. After restoring, the router restarts.
File too large for a backup.
só envia o arquivo; nada muda até você e: only uploads the file; nothing changes until you choose the items.

item(ns). Depois o roteador precisa rein: item(s). Then the router must restart.
A restauração só vale depois do reinício: The restore only takes effect after the restart (about 1 to 2 min without internet).
Testar conexão: confere o caminho aparel: Test connection: checks the device → router → internet path, like the original home page diagram. Detect type: the router probes the WAN port and suggests PPPoE, DHCP or static IP.
O roteador está na rede, mas não alcança: The router is on the network but can't reach the internet
Sugestão: PPPoE (precisa de usuário e se: Suggestion: PPPoE (needs the ISP username and password).
A porta WAN não tem ligação — confira o: The WAN port has no link — check the cable.
Não foi possível identificar o tipo (nor: Couldn't identify the type (normal when PPPoE is already connected). Choose manually.
The 5 GHz Wi-Fi failed to start.
Conflito de IP com o roteador acima dest: IP conflict with the router above this one (the local network uses the same range).
Avisos que a interface original mostra n: Notices the original interface shows under the bell: new version, 5 GHz failure and IP conflict with the router above.
